strings.map.title: سیاحتی مقامات کا نقشہ
strings.map.lead.a: الاحساء کے نخلستان کے نقشے پر {n} مقامات ہیں۔ تلاش کریں یا کوئی زمرہ چنیں۔ فہرست میں یا نقشے پر کسی بھی مقام کو منتخب کریں تو اس کا مختصر تعارف کھل جائے گا۔
strings.map.filter.aria: زمرے کے لحاظ سے مقامات کا انتخاب
strings.map.terrain: زمین کے نشیب و فراز کا سہ جہتی نقشہ
strings.map.list.aria: نقشے پر دکھائے گئے مقامات کی فہرست
strings.map.empty: کوئی نتیجہ نہیں ملا، کوئی دوسرا لفظ یا زمرہ آزمائیں۔

tempted_but_not_added.what: map.lead.a: add that the map works on a phone and a computer alike, or that the list and the map stay in step, or a hint for readers in the Eastern Province (e.g. that the places are within driving distance of Dammam or Riyadh).
tempted_but_not_added.why_not: None of it is in the source (English or Arabic); distances and travel times are facts the page does not state. The device-neutral verb «منتخب کریں» already serves the phone and the laptop reader without a claim.

tempted_but_not_added.what: map.lead.a: a count of the categories («8 زمروں میں سے کوئی ایک») or the size of the oasis.
tempted_but_not_added.why_not: The source names neither; the DECISIONS brief bars both (no number of categories, no oasis size). The count of places is the template's {n}, never typed.

tempted_but_not_added.what: map.terrain: say that the terrain map opens in English («(انگریزی میں)»), or that it shows Jabal Al-Qarah's relief.
tempted_but_not_added.why_not: N308 (closed by the owner 2026-10-15): no language note on /ur/ links to English pages. What the terrain map shows is not in this label's source; and the label must not imply that the classic map is 3D (brief).

tempted_but_not_added.what: map.locate: add that the location is not stored or sent anywhere, to reassure a reader wary of location permissions.
tempted_but_not_added.why_not: The source promises nothing about storage; the brief says map.locate promises no storage.

tempted_but_not_added.what: map.pop.view: «مکمل صفحہ دیکھیں ←» or «مزید معلومات ←» ('full page' / 'more information'), as a Gulf reader might expect from apps.
tempted_but_not_added.why_not: 'Full' and 'more information' characterise the target page; the source says only 'View page'. In the popup, under the place's name and summary, «صفحہ دیکھیں» is already clear.

notes.text: No text change. Each of the twelve was read where it renders (pack `renders`) as a Pakistani Urdu reader living in the Gulf would meet it: on a phone first (the Eastern Province audience reaches the map from the header link «نقشہ» or the index button «نقشے پر دیکھیں»), with a screen reader for the three hidden labels. Nothing in the set needs a cultural gloss: it is interface text with no Arabic generic, no Saudi institution and no religious content. The register is the plain honorific of the approved interface («تلاش کریں», «چنیں», «آزمائیں», «دیکھیں»).

«سیاحتی مقامات کا نقشہ»: in the tab title (+ separator + the Latin brand by the template) and as a shared-link title it says what the page is in the reader's words; a Gulf reader searching in Urdu would type «نقشہ» and «مقامات», both here. No change.

The visible lead and the search snippet. Facts first, in the source's order: where (the map of the Al-Ahsa oasis, named once by N47/P8), how many ({n}, filled by the template), what to do (search or pick a category), what happens (the short introduction opens). «منتخب کریں» suits this audience, who meet the page mostly on a phone but sometimes on a laptop: the Arabic «اضغط» is device-neutral and the Urdu is too. «زمرہ» is the word the attractions index already uses («کوئی زمرہ چنیں»). No change.

The longest label in the chip row, a link to an English-only page. Read as the reader would: «زمین کے نشیب و فراز» is the plain description of hills and hollows, «سہ جہتی» an educated but standard word (Rekhta headword). Pakistani press and film usage writes the transliteration «تھری ڈی» more often (stage 1: ur.wikipedia 607 vs 41), so a reader in the Gulf may know the loan better; that is exactly the open item stage 1 raised under P16/P16-test (condition 2 — a reader stumbling — is not met yet). The text keeps candidate A; the open item stays for stage 4 and the judge, not settled here. No change.

Read as the pair a screen-reader user hears: the button «نقشے پر میری جگہ», and if the browser refuses, the approved «معلوم نہیں ہو سکا کہ آپ کہاں ہیں۔ …». They agree in substance (where I am / where you are). No storage promised. No change.

Spoken «دکھائے گئے مقامات: 12» (say) after each chip tap: the noun phrase before the figure is how an Urdu screen reader announcement reads naturally; the plural stays for a count of 1, as interface counters do. No change.

notes.text: Read in place; nothing for this audience to adapt. map.eyebrow and map.search.ph are approved text reused byte for byte; map.empty is the approved search.empty with the source's category branch. No change.

«مقام / مقامات» throughout (title: «سیاحتی مقامات», the approved section name). facts_added empty: nothing beyond the source. Stage 1's two termbase proposals («سہ جہتی» pending, «نشیب و فراز» verified) are carried by the 01 file for stage 4; stage 3 adds none.
